instruction: Create an area chart comparing Sales and COGS data across all weeks in a new sheet. Title the chart "Revenue vs Cost Comparison".

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating an area chart (filled line chart) with title 'Revenue vs Cost Comparison' in a new sheet. Similar to original but different chart type (area instead of column). Evaluator verifies: 1) Chart type is AreaChartType, 2) Title is correct, 3) Chart is in a new sheet.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical coverage gap: Instruction requires 'comparing Sales and COGS data across all weeks' but evaluator does not verify data series content
Evaluator only checks chart type, title, and sheet location - does not verify Sales data series is present
Evaluator does not verify COGS data series is present
Evaluator does not verify that chart data spans all weeks from the source data
Chart could contain completely wrong data (e.g., only one series, wrong columns, partial data) and still pass verification
Coverage: Only 3 of 6 requirements verified (chart type, title, new sheet) - missing data series and data range verification
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add logic to extract and verify chart data series using chart.series property in openpyxl
Verify that chart contains at least two series with names/references matching 'Sales' and 'COGS' columns
Verify that the data range for each series covers all weeks (check series.val reference spans all data rows)
Consider adding partial credit: 0.25 for chart type, 0.25 for title, 0.2 for new sheet, 0.15 for Sales series, 0.15 for COGS series
Alternative: Simplify instruction to only require 'Create an area chart in a new sheet with title X' if data verification is not feasible
